messages:
diane_cs: Quick sync: customer asked for an evidence export recipe + chain-of-custody for security review. Need concise runbook and a SIEM mapping example. Who can pick this up?

samir_sec: I will draft. Core steps: ticket + retention-hold flag -> generate signed bundle -> manifest with hashes + provenance -> deliver via customer S3 or signed URL -> provide verification instructions.

noah_infra: CLI example to create signed export: `redwood export --tenant t-ACME --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-18 --format ndjson --sign --kms-key projects/acme/kr/ck --out s3://acme-exports/redwood-4382/`

elaine_gov: Legal note: we require a signed data access request from customers for exports. During legal hold do not delete logs. Include `request_id` and `issued_by` in manifest.

lucas_sre: Oncall checklist to attach: create incident, pin retention-hold, run export, verify manifest hashes, snapshot network flows if exfil suspected, notify CSM & legal.

samir_sec: Manifest example line (sanitized): `{ "bundle_id":"bndl-4382","tenant":"t-ACME","exported_by":"samir_sec","exported_at":"2026-03-18T21:20:03Z","kms_key_id":"projects/.../cryptoKeys/ck","bundle_hash":"sha256:abcdef","evidence_refs":["git+https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234"] }`

noah_infra: SIEM field mapping suggestion: redwood_ts -> @timestamp, actor -> user.name, action -> event.action, target -> target.id. Splunk query example: `index=redwood_audit sourcetype=rbac | table _time actor action target bundle_id`

samir_sec: Verification: if customer used CMK we publish bundle digest to audit ledger; customer verifies with their KMS public key. If hosted + Redwood-managed KMS we provide signed manifest and signature blob.

diane_cs: Deliverables: short runbook md, CLI cheat-sheet, sample manifest, SIEM mapping. Can we get a PR by EOD tomorrow?

samir_sec: Yes — PR by 17:00 PT. Tagging @noah_infra and @elaine_gov for review.
